items.t: North Vancouver real estate market stats

faq.q: What is the Capilano area in North Vancouver?
faq.a: The Capilano Road corridor in the District of North Vancouver — the residential streets around Capilano Road between Highway 1 and the Cleveland Dam, taking in Capilano Suspension Bridge Park at 3735 Capilano Road and the Capilano River canyon.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Capilano Road address?
faq.a: Catchments are address-based in SD44. The plateau elementaries beside the corridor are Canyon Heights (4501 Highland Boulevard), Highlands (3150 Colwood Drive) and Cleveland (1255 Eldon Road), with Handsworth Secondary (1033 Handsworth Road) the Handsworth-family secondary school; Capilano Elementary (1230 West 20th Street) is in the lowlands — confirm the exact address with SD44.

faq.q: What buses run on Capilano Road?
faq.a: Route 236 runs the length of Capilano Road toward Grouse Mountain and Lonsdale Quay, route 232 runs via Capilano Road at the corridor's east side, and route 246 crosses via Capilano Road and Montroyal Boulevard with downtown trips over the Lions Gate Bridge.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Capilano NV?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
